Ingest 0.9.9.10

  • Fixed the Workspace menu in Import Photos. You can select any saved workspace, and a single checkmark shows which one is active.

Requires macOS 15 or later and an Apple silicon Mac.

Ingest 0.9.9.9

  • Import from a card with ⌘G. Choose a folder on your SSD, then click a photo to see its final path and optional backup before copying. Save the setup as a workspace for the next card.
  • Browse folders in the current tab. Command-click a folder to open a second tab. The tab bar appears when you need it, and reopening Ingest brings back only the last active source.
  • Copy, Move, Rename, and Organize use the same folder and file naming controls. Import rules, photo groups, and actions open from Options.
  • Manage metadata templates in Settings → Metadata → Templates. Review the changes before applying a template. Metadata Assist keeps Fields and Quick Entry together.
  • Press F1–F4 to show all, selected, tagged, or untagged photos. Rotate with ⌘[ and ⌘], and go back or forward with ⌥⌘[ and ⌥⌘].

Requires macOS 15 or later and an Apple silicon Mac.

Ingest 0.9.9.8

Changed:

  • Sharper exports. Photos sent to a layout and exported at a smaller size keep their fine detail, using the same high-quality resizing as Decks. On-screen previews stay as fast as before.
  • Basic import starts with where to save, with a plain folder chooser. Projects are optional, and the detailed folder and file settings are under Folder and File Options when you need them.
  • Source tabs look like connected tabs, and the selected one is easier to see. Reordering and overflow work as before.
  • When no photos are tagged, the import offers Import All Photos Instead before you review and confirm.

Fixed:

  • Metadata Assist asks you to confirm an incomplete address (like "222 Odenton Maryland") again, instead of saving it as a job question. Newer versions of Apple Intelligence on macOS 27.2 had started slipping it through.

Requires macOS 15 or later and an Apple silicon Mac.
